evals.prompt: We sell a $49 one-time template pack. What should our conversion goal be?
evals.expected_output: Lists candidates, considers how often purchases happen, picks one goal with an exact detection rule (purchase webhook or checkout success URL), suggests a value, and takes or plans a dated baseline.
assertions: Plans or records a dated baseline
Considers whether the goal happens often enough

evals.prompt: Set our goal to time on site, we want people engaged.
evals.expected_output: Pushes back that time on site isn't a conversion, offers the nearest real action (sign-up or newsletter join) and defines it.
assertions: Does not accept time on site as the goal
Defines how that action is detected
